items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: I guess he made trips up there, but I've only read this from later. I didn't meet him up there or know of him up there.

ctx.x: First of all, there were so many musicians that you met. That union floor and the street around the union floor after union hours was just loaded with musicians and you don't remember, you know, you just didn't get their name or associate with them. And then the other thing that operates is the fact that I've forgotten a lot of the fellows' names. I've tried to recall in my own mind sometimes, many of the people that I work with, I can remember their face and the fact that I'm working with them better than I can…
Well, what about, say, Tony Almarico, was he up there for them? That period I'm trying to remember, or did you know him?
I guess he made trips up there, but I've only read this from later. I didn't meet him up there or know of him up there.
